system.description: Permanently converts your vitae into organic acid. Any Blood Trait that contacts something other than you inflicts two levels of aggravated damage; anyone drinking your vitae takes four levels of aggravated damage per Blood Trait. When a penetrating attack injures you in close combat, make a Simple Test; on a win, you lose one Blood Trait that sprays toward your attacker, who must win a Static Physical Challenge (difficulty five) or take one level of aggravated damage. Objects piercing you corrode away within minutes, and stakes dissolve within five turns.
